user_questions.question: What net-points thresholds define each tier (Explorer, Insider, Pronto Plus, Pronto One, Pronto Elite)? No thresholds exist in the org. Recommendation: none possible; a business value is needed.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Explorer 0-999, Insider 1000-4999, Pronto Plus 5000-9999, Pronto One 10000-24999, Pronto Elite 25000+.

user_questions.question: How is the points balance computed? Options: (a) net = SUM of Earn Points__c minus SUM of Redeem Points__c (Redeem stored positive); (b) Redeem stored as negative numbers, balance = SUM of all Points__c; (c) lifetime Earn only. Evidence: Transaction_Type__c has Earn/Redeem; 0 transaction records, so no data settles the sign. Recommendation: (a).
user_questions.simulated_answer: Net points: Earn minus Redeem across all Loyalty Transactions.

user_questions.question: Should the tier always follow the balance, including downgrades and overwriting tiers set by hand (Agentforce_Reference_App and sfdc_accelerate_dms can edit Loyalty_Tier__c), or only upgrade? Recommendation: always follow, recalculated on every transaction insert/update/delete.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Recalculate on every loyalty transaction insert/update/delete. Tiers can go down.

skill_friction: No sfdx-project.json in the project: the AskCoworker header requires a sourceApiVersion and the skill does not say what to put (used the org apiVersion and said so).

Wrong-claim counting (Rule 3) is ambiguous for fabricated [Verified: ...] labels (e.g. 'FieldPermissions SOQL returned 0 rows' for fields that do not exist yet) and for over-reaching inferences (Data Cloud 'already ingests' with 0 DataStreams); unclear whether these count as wrong claims. Counting them reached four and allowed skipping T, which removed the only external review of open decisions.
The R/T split rule (>4 established facts => split R into runtime and security halves) doubles R calls for small inventories (4 rows) where one R call would likely fit the time limit.

The skill does not say whether an internal helper field that only a system-context flow reads counts as a field 'people use' (content rule requiring access and placement); had to decide no grants and list visibility as a proposal.

No guidance that roll-up summary creation recalculates values without firing parent flows/triggers, so existing parents need a backfill save; handled as a non-blocking data step from general knowledge.

Step 5 says to send one question message after D1 and step 3, but spec-format and askcoworker-calls give no template slot for recording the simulated answers' mapping when the answer (e.g. 'tiers can go down') covers a question only indirectly (hand-edit overwrite); mapped per scope.md 'answer that picks no option'.
Hit the documented FlowDefinitionView OR-returns-empty trap despite the note; the note could be surfaced in the 'Existing automation' checklist, not only in API notes.
